summary: Implemented full window-function execution support in sqlglot's Python executor. Added planner phases for windows/QUALIFY/projection, efficient partition sorting and frame evaluation (ROWS/RANGE/GROUPS and EXCLUDE), ranking, aggregate and navigation functions including IGNORE NULLS, named-window inheritance, grouped-window composition, DISTINCT/ORDER/LIMIT integration, and safe window subquery handling. Preserved qualified join sorting and prevented unsafe optimizer unnesting of window subqueries. Validated against SQLite window semantics across randomized frames/ranking/navigation/exclusion cases, exercised grouped, join, CTE, correlated and quantified subqueries, and benchmarked 50,000-row cases well below required limits.
